# Standard Care Hospice
> Hospice and palliative care at home across Orange, Riverside, and San Diego counties, California — in English, Vietnamese, Spanish, Korean, Japanese, Arabic, and more. Typically covered by Medicare and Medi-Cal with no co-pays or deductibles for services related to the hospice diagnosis. 24/7 line: (949) 426-1693.
